# Hyeseung (Helen) Kim

> Junior Consultant at Kearney's Seoul office, a global management consulting firm. Works on due diligence, market entry and cost projects, usually starting from a hypothesis and testing it in expert and customer interviews. Projects so far: commercial due diligence on a power transformer maker, an investment thesis for an indie K-beauty skincare brand, a map of the global drone market, market entry for a semiconductor back-end consumables maker, and (now) cost analysis of automotive head-up displays. Before Kearney: internships at Bain & Company and Boston Consulting Group; Business Administration at Yonsei University. Also shoots 35mm film and sings in bands. Based in Seoul.
